name: Little Yuri Love Nest
source:
Thrown out of heaven for teaching humanity writing, the fallen angel now spends her time researching topics others don't know exist and petting her wee firegoat. When she raises her head from her book after a few years, she discovers her succubus girlfriend has gone to the Up World. Sigh. The angel will have to find her and get her home before a zealot takes over their little circle of hell.

[From [url=https://alternativewonders.itch.io/little-yuri-love-nest]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
因为向人类传授文字而被逐出天堂的堕天使，如今整日沉浸于钻研世人闻所未闻的冷门课题，顺便撸一撸自家那只小巧的火焰山羊。当她时隔数年终于从书页间抬起头来时，却惊讶地发现自己的魅魔女友竟然跑去了地上人间。唉……在狂热信徒趁虚而入霸占她们温馨的地狱小窝之前，这位天使不得不动身去找回女友、带她回家。

[摘自[url=https://alternativewonders.itch.io/little-yuri-love-nest]itch.io[/url]]
